purpose: Outcome-blind effective-dated company-level supply-chain edge validation.
falsification: Supplier award does not prove procurement share, exclusivity, product volume, or current continuity beyond the stated vintage.
Anonymous procurement concentration does not authorize identity inference from historical named suppliers or award lists.
Product/material relevance alone does not create a bilateral issuer edge.
requiredForL3: At least two issuer-native named bilateral edges with bounded product scope and effective-date semantics.
At least one issuer-native replacement/termination/expiry negative-control edge.
